neighbours.label: a verb of deliberately watching or looking at something as an activity ('interesting to watch', 'look at', 'watch what/where') and its complement; the noun 'watch' (timepiece) and passive 'see' stay low
fire: The crowd gathered on the bridge to watch the boats race below.
It was funny to watch the puppies chase their own tails.
Before you try the dance, watch how the teacher moves her feet.
We spent the evening looking at the stars from the porch.
Kids love to watch the trains pass by the station.
It is amazing to watch a spider build its web at dawn.
Stand back and watch what happens when the vinegar hits the soda.
She stopped at the gallery to look at the new paintings.
